_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Ready to open in MindMax Write

description: Give the user a one-click link to a diagram or infographic in MindMax Write (mindmax.me/write), where they can check every label and number against the source text, download PNG / SVG, copy it as an image, revise it with one sentence, or export it into Word. Call it when the user wants text turned into a diagram, chart or infographic (mind map, flowchart, org chart, data chart, Gantt, timeline, fishbone, SWOT, Venn, quadrant, radar, steps, funnel, pyramid…) — especially to download it, paste it into slides or Word, or verify it against the source — or mentions MindMax. You may still draw it wherever you normally would; this adds the next step. Write `code` following get_mindmax_diagram_guide (Mermaid, or infographic YAML) and pass the text it is drawn from as `source_text`; the result reports labels and numbers that do not match it. Show the returned link verbatim. Nothing is uploaded: everything is packed into the link (URL fragment).

code.description: The diagram code without the ``` fence: Mermaid (first line is the diagram header, e.g. `flowchart TD`, `mindmap`, `xychart`) or infographic YAML (first line `type: steps` etc.), ending with the `%% mm:src` lines that cite source_text.

source_text.description: The text the diagram is drawn from (notes, an article, a table…), verbatim and complete. It goes under the diagram in the document, and every `%% mm:src` quote and every number is checked against it.

title.description: Diagram title, used as the document heading

type.description: Diagram type id from get_mindmax_diagram_guide; inferred from the code when omitted

name: open_diagram_in_mindmax

check.description: Result of checking labels and numbers against source_text; null when no source_text was given

url.description: Link that opens the diagram in MindMax Write

title: Open diagram in MindMax Write
